messages:
maria_cs: FYI incoming escalation from ACME — their ingest pipeline started failing after today's canary. They say arrays in the "items" field are being split across lines and their parser (line-delimited JSON) throws "Unexpected end of JSON".

maria_cs: example from customer (copied from their logs):
```json
{"order_id": "1234", "items": [
  {"sku": "A1", "qty": 1},
  {"sku": "B2",
"qty": 2}
]}
```

alan_support: oof, that looks like streaming chunk boundary got injected mid-object. any request ids or model version?

maria_cs: provided request id: req_0a9f3b, model: redwood-v2-2q3a-canary (they didn't get exact hash). Happened around 2026-03-15 15:12 UTC.

deployment_bot: deploy 2026-03-15T14:55Z: canary rollout redwood-v2-2q3a (runtime flag: enable_streaming=true)

ivan_infra: pulling logs for req_0a9f3b now. saw response body sent as two events: first chunk ends inside object, second chunk resumed — looks like streaming enabled at runtime layer.

nina_eng: couple hypotheses: 1) model variant's tokenizer/chunk boundaries shifted and runtime didn't coalesce final chunk before closing stream, 2) our newline-splitting logic for ndjson got triggered if a chunk contained '\n' at boundary. i'll repro locally with streaming=true and model redwood-v2-2q3a.

maria_cs: customer says their parser expects a single complete JSON per line (ndjson). If we stream partial objects across events, it breaks their consumer. They want either full-line NDJSON or explicit chunk markers.

nina_eng: creating repro: prompt + config used?

maria_cs: sample prompt they sent: "Produce JSON array 'items' with objects for each product. Output must be a single-line JSON per order." They also attached conversation id. I'll DM the file.

nina_eng: repro successful: when streaming enabled and sequence length > 800 tokens, runtime emitted partial object boundaries. Root cause looks like continuous batching + streaming heuristics didn't flush with object boundary awareness.

ivan_infra: we have a hotfix idea: coalesce tokens until a top-level JSON delimiter ']' or '}' seen when streaming to ndjson customer, or provide a option to buffer until newline for NDJSON consumers.

nina_eng: opened tracking issue INF-3894, pushing patch to runtime to buffer top-level containers for ndjson compatibility. will run canary test against ACME dataset.

deployment_bot: rollback initiated for redwood-v2-2q3a canary for tenant acme-corp at 16:05 UTC

maria_cs: telling ACME we're pausing canary for them and working on fix. keeping them updated.

alan_support: thanks team. keeping ticket high priority.

maria_cs: closing loop: customer accepts temporary workaround. I'll confirm after patch verification and re-run canary with buffered streaming.
